findings.title: Dead empty class Class1.cs in Infrastructure project
findings.evidence: File deleted. No references to Class1 found in codebase.

findings.title: Near-identical IsTotalOrder and IsValidOrder methods in GraphValidationService
findings.evidence: Shared BuildTopologicalGraph (line 44) and TryTopologicalSort (line 114) extracted. IsTotalOrder (line 147) and IsValidOrder (line 160) are now 13-line thin wrappers calling TryTopologicalSort with checkUnique param.

findings.title: Swallowed exception in database restore path
findings.evidence: Original catch block in Program.cs removed. Exception handling moved to BackupService.TryRestoreBackupAsync (line 47-59) which uses ILogger.LogError(ex, ...) to log full exception with stack trace.

findings.title: Widespread var usage violations against .editorconfig mandate
findings.evidence: ~35+ explicit-type local variable declarations remain where var should be used per editorconfig: csharp_style_var_for_built_in_types=true:suggestion, csharp_style_var_when_type_is_apparent=true:suggestion, csharp_style_var_elsewhere=true:suggestion. Worst offenders: GraphValidationService.cs (7 violations), BradleyTerryResolutionService.cs (7), scoring services (10+).

findings.title: No sealed classes anywhere in the codebase
findings.evidence: 21 public classes remain unsealed. Only UnionFind (GraphValidationService.cs:11) was sealed. None of the 21 classes are designed for inheritance. JIT devirtualization optimization (CA1852) still inhibited across the codebase.

findings.title: Large methods exceeding 50-line maintainability threshold
findings.evidence: GetSortedTiers reduced from 97 to 38 lines. IsTotalOrder/IsValidOrder now 13 lines each. BUT: ResolveGlobalStrengths still 115 lines (BradleyTerryResolutionService.cs:14-128). New extracted BuildTopologicalGraph is 69 lines (GraphValidationService.cs:44-112).

findings.title: Inefficient client-side join in SqliteEntryRepository queries
findings.evidence: Same O(n*m) FirstOrDefault pattern persists inside loops at SqliteRepositories.cs:84 (GetByIdAsync) and SqliteRepositories.cs:108 (GetAllAsync): categories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == scoreEntity.CategoryId). No navigation property or .Include() added.

findings.title: Magic numbers without named constants
findings.evidence: Same magic numbers untouched: 1e-9 in LinearSpacingScoring.cs:57 and DefinedIntervalScoring.cs:50; 50/10 in BradleyTerryResolutionService.cs:90; 1e-3 in BradleyTerryResolutionService.cs:108.

findings.title: Tuple<string, string> should be ValueTuple (string, string)
findings.evidence: Judging.razor.cs:36 and :130 still use reference-type Tuple<string, string>. Change to (string A, string B)? suggestedPair and assignment with (a, b) syntax not applied.

findings.title: Missing sealed on private nested UnionFind class
findings.evidence: UnionFind now declared as private sealed class UnionFind at GraphValidationService.cs:11.

findings.title: GetSortedTiers duplicates topological sort logic from TryTopologicalSort
findings.evidence_snippet: GetSortedTiers (line 173-210) manually copies inDegree, creates a new queue, and runs the same Kahn's algorithm as TryTopologicalSort (line 114-145). The only difference is tier-based grouping of results. TryTopologicalSort could return the sorted list, then GetSortedTiers could group it into tiers.
findings.rule_violated: DRY principle — core BFS-based topological sort logic exists in two places
findings.remediation: Have TryTopologicalSort return the sorted list (already does via out param). Have GetSortedTiers call TryTopologicalSort then group the result into tiers using inDegree breadth levels — or extend TryTopologicalSort to return tier info.

findings.title: New backup service classes not sealed
findings.evidence_snippet:
public class BackupService : IBackupService { }
public class DatabaseBackupService : IDatabaseBackupService { }
findings.rule_violated: CA1852 — neither class has visible subclasses; JIT cannot devirtualize interface dispatch through them
findings.remediation: Add sealed modifier to both classes.

findings.title: Inconsistent namespace/style in new backup files
findings.rule_violated: dotnet format reports WHITESPACE errors requiring usings before namespace declaration. The new files break the established pattern of block-scoped namespaces used throughout the 27 existing files.
findings.remediation: Move usings before the namespace declaration (standard C# 10+ convention for file-scoped namespaces) OR convert new files to block-scoped namespaces for consistency.

findings.title: New BuildTopologicalGraph method exceeds 50-line threshold
findings.evidence_snippet: BuildTopologicalGraph spans 69 lines (lines 44-112) performing three distinct operations: UnionFind construction (11 lines), root-member grouping (16 lines), and adjacency/in-degree graph building (35 lines).
findings.rule_violated: Method length >50 lines; the method handles multiple concerns (union-find init, component grouping, edge processing) that could be split further.
findings.remediation: Extract edge-processing loop (lines 75-109) into a separate private method (e.g., BuildAdjacencyGraph) to bring BuildTopologicalGraph under 50 lines.
